chapter: Later tours, illness and the union job
title: More dates with Lyttelton and Alex Welsh
summary: He returned a few times to play with Lyttelton and recalls meeting Alex Welsh at Essen.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Then I went back, I went back and I didn't play too many more dates with Humphrey because I had come home from that special trip. But then I went back to or three other times and played with Humphrey. Which was a gas, you know.
Did they play with that Alex Welsh band in England?
No, you never did. That was another one that.....
Yes. A lot of people went over and played with them.
I played In Essen, Germany at a festival there where he was on the bill and I used to talk with him, you know, but I never did play, I was supposed to have played with his band in '68.
